title: Enijaṅgha
text: Enijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ || appāhāram alolupaṃ || sīhaṃ v-ekacaraṃ nāgam ||kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ || upasaṅkamma pucchāma || kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatīti || || Pañcakāmaguṇā loke || mano chaṭṭhā paveditā || ettha chandaṃ virājetvā || evaṃ dukkhā pamuccatīti || || Satti-vaggo tatiyo || || Tatr-uddānam || Sattiyā Phusati c-eva || Jaṭā Manonivāraṇā || Arahantena Pajjoto || Sarā Mahaddhanena ca || Catucakkena navamaṃ || Enijaṅghena te dasāti || || ___________________________________________ CHAPTER IV. SATULLAPAKĀYIKA-VAGGA
